# sfcompute_platform_constants (Data Source)

Reads platform constants from SF Compute (`GET /preview/v2/platform_constants`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `allocation_schedule_grid` (Attributes) When an allocation schedule can start or end. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allocation_schedule_grid))
- `compute_limit_offset_price_ceiling_dollars_per_node_hour` (String) Price ceiling for standing limit sell orders to offset [compute limit usage](https://docs.sfcompute.com/preview/limits#compute-limits), expressed as a decimal string in dollars per node-hour. `null` means sell orders do not offset usage.

<a id="nestedatt--allocation_schedule_grid"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allocation_schedule_grid`

Read-Only:

- `time_grid` (List of Number) The times an order or transfer can start or end at, as Unix timestamps in ascending order. An order or transfer can also start at the current time.
